title: Stasis Eye Motorcycle
description: A surreal psychedelic scene dominated by a giant flaming eye in a starry sky watching over a red demon riding a flaming motorcycle. Below, a woman in a red cape holds a lantern casting yellow light, while green and yellow horses gallop across a swirling vortex lake. A gothic castle with red windows and the text STASIS and JLX3 appears in the background.
